The studio / our approach

Glass is never just glass.

It is a moment made visible. A trace of movement. A little bit of light, caught and given a place to live. Glasshouse is a fictional studio imagining objects that make the everyday feel extraordinary.

We embrace the tiny variations that come from making by hand: the soft edges, the shifting color, the evidence of a human touch.
